text: Security is a key part of web development. Every website should use HTTPS to protect data while it travels between the user and the server. Authentication helps make sure that only the right people can access an account. Input validation is also important, because it stops users from sending harmful data to the system. Developers must also know about common vulnerabilities, such as SQL injection and cross-site scripting, which can damage a website or steal private information. By following good security practices, developers can build safer websites and protect their users from online attacks.
